title: Enhancing Vibrational Light-Matter Coupling Strength beyond the Molecular Concentration Limit Using Plasmonic Arrays
notes: No introduction, methods or SI in the packet, so HYP, DES and PRC nodes are text with requires_unseen. Spine: sqrt(C) ceiling -> plasmon array as a third resonator -> nanorod arrays of five lengths in an FP cavity -> plasmon tuning -> 3 cavity-plasmon polaritons -> three-component coupling 220/202 cm-1 -> beyond the concentration limit. Control branch: cavity+molecule only (Rabi 101/46 cm-1, strong-coupling regime, fitted g 41/18 cm-1). Second branch: polariton linewidth narrowing (~70 cm-1) explained by suppressed radiative damping. Audits: a1 the paper's own 'crude assumptions', a2 the non-dispersing artifact bands in F5, a3 the cavity thicknesses used for the F5 simulations (10.8/8.5/10.4 um) do not match those used for the F6 fits (9.7/8.0/10.1 um). Packet oddities: F1 is the TOC/abstract graphic and F2 the journal cover thumbnail, both caption-less and carrying no data, yet both are offered as whole-figure panels; F3-F6 are paper Figures 1-4, so packet figure ids are offset by two from the paper's. F5 is tier C3_caption_swap with no crops, and the caption's blue dash-dot polariton guides are not discernible in the packet image, so the '2+1=3 polaritons' count had to be taken from F6a rather than F5a. The F4b/F4c splittings read by eye (~110 and ~65 cm-1) are larger than the caption's 101 and 46 cm-1. The key quantities (220, 202, 172, 41, 18, 70, 84 cm-1) all live in the linked text; the figures show the fits, not the numbers.
